content_data.meeting_title: Performance Optimization Architecture Review - Patient Data Processing Pipeline
agenda_items: Resource allocation for load testing infrastructure
GDPR compliance impact on performance optimization approaches
key_decisions: Migrate from PostgreSQL to TimescaleDB for time-series patient monitoring data to reduce query latency by 60%
Implement Redis cluster with data residency controls for each EU region to comply with healthcare regulations
technical_blockers: Insufficient observability into cross-service transaction traces for diagnosing performance degradation
Legacy SOAP-based integration with third-party lab systems creating bottleneck in results processing pipeline
